# Synthetic password fixtures

Original synthetic files, generated with the test VM's 7-Zip. No user data.
Test password: `Listi-test-only`. ZIP methods: ZipCrypto, AES128, AES256.

Contents: `alpha.txt` = `Private fixture alpha\n`,
`beta.txt` = `Private fixture beta\n`. The encrypted 7z contains alpha only.
These tiny fixtures exercise the optional system reader and can be redistributed
under the repository's MIT license.
